description: This file is a shell script testing various corner cases and functionalities of 'git-archive' and related git commands. It includes tests for empty trees, with different archive formats (tar, zip), large files, long paths, and archive integrity checks.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory with the given name and registers a cleanup command to remove it after use.

methods.name: check_dir
methods.description: Checks that a directory contains exactly the expected set of files and paths.

methods.name: build_tree
methods.description: Builds a git tree object with long path names derived from the provided hash for testing archive handling of long paths.
